description.en: CPU emulation, hardware model, language and I/O settings.
description.zh-Hans: CPU 模拟、机型、语言与读取设置。

description.en: 'Dynarec (JIT)' is by far the fastest and should be used in almost all cases. 'IR Interpreter' is slower but more stable, and 'Interpreter' is for troubleshooting only.
description.zh-Hans: 「动态编译」速度最快，绝大多数情况下都应使用；「IR 解释执行」稍慢但更稳定；「解释执行」最慢，仅用于排查问题。

description.en: Skip memory access checks for speed. A few games may crash with it enabled.
description.zh-Hans: 跳过内存访问检查以提升速度，少数游戏可能因此崩溃。

description.en: Ignore invalid memory accesses instead of reporting them, which keeps some games running.
description.zh-Hans: 忽略游戏的非法内存访问而不是报错，可避免部分游戏中断运行。

description.en: How long reading game data takes. 'Fast' is quickest; 'Simulate UMD delays' reproduces real disc timing, which a few games depend on.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟读取游戏数据的耗时。「快速」读取最快；「模拟 UMD 延迟」还原真机的光盘读取速度，个别依赖读取时间的游戏需要。

description.en: Sync to the real clock: slightly slower, but with less input lag.
description.zh-Hans: 按真实时钟同步运行，速度略慢但输入延迟更低。

description.en: Lock the emulated PSP CPU to a fixed speed. Raising it reduces slowdown; the real hardware ran between 222MHz and 333MHz.
description.zh-Hans: 把模拟 PSP 的 CPU 锁定在指定频率。提高可减少卡顿，降低可省电。真机为 222MHz 到 333MHz。

description.en: Simulate inserting or ejecting the Memory Stick, which some games ask you to do.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟记忆棒的插拔。部分游戏需要拔出再插入记忆棒才能继续。

description.en: Load the whole disc image into RAM for faster access, at a large cost in memory.
description.zh-Hans: 把整个游戏镜像读入内存，读取更快，但占用大量内存。

description.en: The emulated PSP's system language, which multi-language games follow. 'Automatic' uses the app language.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟 PSP 的系统语言，多语言游戏会跟随这个设置显示对应语言。「自动」跟随 App 的语言。

description.en: Which PSP to emulate. The PSP-2000/3000 has more memory, which some games and homebrew require.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟的 PSP 机型。PSP-2000/3000 内存更大，部分游戏和自制程序需要。

description.en: Backend, resolution, frameskip and texture settings.
description.zh-Hans: 渲染后端、分辨率、跳帧与纹理设置。

description.en: The graphics API to render with. 'Automatic' follows RetroGo's video driver setting.
description.zh-Hans: 使用的图形接口。「自动」跟随 RetroGo 的视频驱动设置。

description.en: Render on the CPU: very slow but the most accurate, mainly for troubleshooting.
description.zh-Hans: 用 CPU 渲染画面，速度很慢但最准确，一般只用于排查画面问题。

description.en: Render at a multiple of the PSP's native resolution. Higher is sharper and more demanding.
description.zh-Hans: 以 PSP 原生分辨率的若干倍渲染。倍数越高画面越清晰，性能开销也越大。

description.en: Multisample anti-aliasing for smoother edges. Vulkan only.
description.zh-Hans: 多重采样抗锯齿等级，边缘更平滑。仅 Vulkan 可用。

description.en: Remove one line from the top and bottom for an exact 16:9 picture.
description.zh-Hans: 上下各裁掉一行像素，得到精确的 16:9 比例。

description.en: Skip frames for performance at the cost of smoothness.
description.zh-Hans: 跳过部分画面以提升性能，代价是画面不够流畅。

description.en: Skip a fixed number of frames, or skip based on a percentage of the frame rate.
description.zh-Hans: 按固定帧数跳帧，还是按帧率百分比跳帧。

description.en: Skip frames automatically when the device cannot keep up.
description.zh-Hans: 性能不足时自动跳帧以维持速度。

description.en: Repeat frames up to 60Hz, which makes games that run at lower frame rates look smoother.
description.zh-Hans: 重复输出画面把帧率补到 60Hz，让原本低帧率运行的游戏看起来更顺滑。

description.en: Notify the frontend when the game's frame rate changes so it can adjust.
description.zh-Hans: 游戏帧率变化时通知前端调整同步方式。

description.en: How many frames of graphics commands to buffer. Less buffering means lower input lag but lower speed.
description.zh-Hans: 缓冲的图形指令帧数。缓冲越少输入延迟越低，但速度也越慢。

description.en: Do vertex transforms on the GPU, which is much faster. Disable only to diagnose rendering problems.
description.zh-Hans: 由 GPU 完成顶点变换，速度更快。关闭仅用于排查画面问题。

description.en: Combine skinned model draws on the CPU, which is faster in most games.
description.zh-Hans: 在 CPU 上合并骨骼模型的绘制，多数游戏会更快。

description.en: Generate curves on the GPU, which looks smoother in the games that use them.
description.zh-Hans: 由 GPU 生成曲面，部分游戏画面更平滑。

description.en: The algorithm used to upscale textures. xBRZ suits pixel art, while Bicubic is smoother.
description.zh-Hans: 放大纹理使用的算法。xBRZ 适合像素风格，Bicubic 更平滑。

description.en: How much to upscale textures. Very CPU heavy; some textures are scaled later to avoid stutter.
description.zh-Hans: 纹理放大的倍数。非常吃 CPU，部分纹理会延迟处理以免卡顿。

description.en: Fix the color banding that texture upscaling can introduce.
description.zh-Hans: 修正纹理放大后出现的色带问题。

description.en: Upscale textures with a GPU shader, which is much faster than on the CPU. Vulkan only, and it overrides the texture upscale type.
description.zh-Hans: 用 GPU 着色器放大纹理，比 CPU 放大快得多。仅 Vulkan 可用，开启后会覆盖「纹理放大算法」。

description.en: Keep textures viewed at an angle, such as the ground, sharper.
description.zh-Hans: 让倾斜角度的纹理（例如地面）更清晰。

description.en: How textures are filtered. 'Nearest' keeps pixels crisp and 'Linear' is smoother.
description.zh-Hans: 纹理的过滤方式。「最近点」保留像素感，「线性」更平滑。

description.en: Switch to nearest filtering in some 2D games to remove unnecessary blur.
description.zh-Hans: 对部分 2D 游戏自动改用最近点过滤，消除不必要的模糊。

description.en: Load community-made high-resolution texture packs.
description.zh-Hans: 加载自制的高清纹理替换包。

description.en: Confirmation button and analog stick settings.
description.zh-Hans: 确认键与摇杆设置。

description.en: Which button confirms in the system menus. Japanese games usually use Circle, Western ones Cross.
description.zh-Hans: 系统界面中用哪个键确认。日版游戏多用圆圈，欧美版多用叉。

description.en: Compensate for circular stick gates so diagonals can reach full range.
description.zh-Hans: 为圆形限位的摇杆做补偿，使其能达到对角方向的最大值。

title.en: Analog Circle vs Square Gate Compensation

description.en: An extra deadzone applied on top of RetroGo's own input.
description.zh-Hans: 在 RetroGo 输入之外额外增加的摇杆死区。

description.en: An extra sensitivity factor applied on top of RetroGo's own input.
description.zh-Hans: 在 RetroGo 输入之外额外施加的摇杆灵敏度系数。

description.en: Speed hacks that trade accuracy for performance and can cause rendering errors.
description.zh-Hans: 以准确性换取性能的手段，可能导致画面错误。

description.en: Skip effects that render to a buffer. Much faster, but some games may draw nothing at all.
description.zh-Hans: 跳过需要渲染到缓冲区的特效，速度明显提升，但部分游戏可能什么都画不出来。

description.en: Turn off geometry culling, which fixes missing models in some games.
description.zh-Hans: 关闭图形剔除，可修复部分游戏模型缺失的问题。

description.en: Skip reading data back from the GPU for speed. Games that rely on readbacks will break.
description.zh-Hans: 跳过从 GPU 读回数据，速度更快。部分游戏依赖回读，开启后会出错。

description.en: Faster texture caching that can cause text problems in a few games.
description.zh-Hans: 延迟处理纹理缓存以提升速度，少数游戏的文字可能显示异常。

description.en: How finely curves are subdivided, which only some games use.
description.zh-Hans: 曲面的细分精度，只有部分游戏会用到。

description.en: Render effects at a lower resolution, which reduces artifacts at higher resolutions.
description.zh-Hans: 用较低分辨率渲染特效，可减少提高分辨率后出现的画面瑕疵。
